"""Diagnostic cProfile of the exact pinned infrastructure manifests; no live stack."""

import cProfile
import hashlib
import io
import json
import os
import pstats

import yaml

from util.bazel.runfiles import get_required_path
from util.testing.undeclared_outputs import undeclared_outputs_dir


def test_manifest_profile() -> None:
    output = undeclared_outputs_dir()
    results = []
    for index, name in enumerate(("CERT_MANAGER", "TRUST_MANAGER", "KUBEVIRT", "KYVERNO")):
        raw = get_required_path(os.environ[name]).read_bytes()
        text = raw.decode()
        parsed = {}
        order: list[tuple[str, type[yaml.SafeLoader] | type[yaml.CSafeLoader]]] = [
            ("python_safe", yaml.SafeLoader),
            ("c_safe", yaml.CSafeLoader),
        ]
        if index % 2:
            order.reverse()
        for loader_name, loader in order:
            profile = cProfile.Profile()
            parsed[loader_name] = profile.runcall(list, yaml.load_all(text, Loader=loader))
            profile.dump_stats(str(output / f"{name}-{loader_name}.pstats"))
            stream = io.StringIO()
            stats = pstats.Stats(profile, stream=stream)
            stats.sort_stats("cumulative").print_stats(30)
            (output / f"{name}-{loader_name}.txt").write_text(stream.getvalue())
            results.append(
                {
                    "manifest": name,
                    "loader": loader_name,
                    "bytes": len(raw),
                    "sha256": hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(),
                    "documents": len(parsed[loader_name]),
                    "profile_seconds": stats.get_stats_profile().total_tt,
                }
            )
        assert parsed["python_safe"] == parsed["c_safe"], name
    (output / "manifest-profile.json").write_text(json.dumps(results, indent=2) + "\n")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    import pytest_bazel

    pytest_bazel.main()
